trigger_condition: routed_model_label or routed_model is whitespace-only string, not empty
potential_consequence: Renders '— ' with only whitespace after the em dash, unlike toolName which trims

trigger_condition: config.label is the function variant of CredentialFieldConfig['label'] (string | (values)=>string)
potential_consequence: Function object passed directly as label prop instead of being invoked; old code resolved it via getPlaceholder

trigger_condition: a textarea or select field sets an explicit label (as sharepoint's input fields now do)
guard_snippet: label={label ?? getLabel(placeholder)} // mirror the input-type precedence fix
potential_consequence: textarea/select branches still ignore any explicit label and always truncate the placeholder-derived text, unlike the now-fixed input branch

trigger_condition: a later streamed chunk sends a partial routing object missing fields set by an earlier chunk
potential_consequence: Whole-object replace drops previously known routed_model_label/routed_model when a later chunk only carries e.g. classifier_cost_usd

trigger_condition: backend explicitly sends routing: null to clear a prior routing assignment
potential_consequence: ?? treats explicit null as nullish and keeps the stale prior routing value instead of clearing it
A real $0 classifier cost is indistinguishable from the classifier not running at all; row silently omitted while Money spent still shows $0

trigger_condition: backend populates Thought.routing.classifier_cost_usd or requested_model_money_spent per thought
